**Missouri AG Sends Cease-and-Desist Letters to Six Prediction Market Operators: The Sports Geek**
Missouri’s attorney general has sent cease-and-desist letters to six prediction-market operators. The Sports Geek reported those letters on September 23, 2026, as an enforcement step by Missouri’s attorney general against the operators.
Source: https://www.thesportsgeek.com/blog/missouri-ag-sends-cease-and-desist-letters-six-prediction-markets/

### New and Notable
Polymarket posted a new market, Nothing Ever Happens: September, on the morning of September 23, 2026. The listing puts a month, rather than one candidate or one match, into a single question.
